brands.evidence: Choose Monzo if you want the best app experience, automated budgeting, and fee-free spending abroad.
Choose Nationwide if you want branch access, member-only savings rates, a £50 interest-free overdraft buffer

client_claims.text: Both offer free standard accounts and FSCS protection up to £120,000
Monzo offers fee-free card spending worldwide at the Mastercard rate.
Free ATM withdrawals up to £400/30 days in the EEA (£200 outside).
2.80% AER (variable) in Instant Access Savings Pots.
Monzo Perks boosts Instant Access savings to 3.55% AER
client_claims.note: Facts cover only the free plan rate.

client_claims.text: Cash deposits cost £1 per deposit at PayPoint or the Post Office; cheques can be scanned in-app.
Arranged overdrafts charged at 19%, 29%, or 39% EAR depending on credit score; no free buffer.
Monzo Max charges an extra £4/month for family cover and includes travel, phone insurance and breakdown cover.
Monzo Perks includes an annual Railcard, weekly Greggs treat, monthly Vue ticket, Uber One and YouTube Premium Lite.
